eras.title: Brick towers after the capital
eras.caption: Ayutthaya's surviving prangs and brick walls stand among the remains of monasteries. Their broken rooflines show what was lost when the capital was destroyed in 1767, while the scale of the precincts recalls a major river-based trading city.
